policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet for Pro subscribers, enabling AI agents to make purchases using eligible US-issued cards.
Microsoft announced that its services, including Outlook and Teams, have been fully restored after a global outage affected numerous organizations worldwide.

world.summary: The Bank of England's chief economist indicated that further interest rate rises are probable in the coming months to address inflation.
Reports suggest Russian casualties in the Ukraine war have reached 450,000, impacting the conflict primarily through older men, poorer regions, and foreign recruits.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that the United States has for the first time proposed Ukraine cede territory in Donbas in exchange for NATO membership.
A trilateral meeting between leaders from the US, China, and Russia is anticipated at APEC, with a nuclear treaty and the US's war on Iran among the priority discussion topics.

us.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration lifted a nationwide ground stop for all departing flights, which officials later attributed to outdated equipment that became overloaded.
More than 30 people were injured, though no fatalities occurred, after a tanker collided with a cruise ship in the Port of New Orleans.
In North Dakota, lawmakers from both parties collaborated to cap insulin prices for patients, joining a national trend to protect individuals with diabetes.

science.summary: The James Webb Space Telescope has discovered ice that predates the star it orbits, providing new insights into planetary building materials.
A new wrist device developed by researchers in Nottingham is proving life-changing for individuals with Tourette syndrome by helping to manage tics.
